21520_kyogen.concern: 狂言 is read きょうげん (long ō), so it is not a homophone of 虚言 (きょげん); it is only a near-sound-alike.
21520_kyogen.suggestion: Say the two words sound similar (きょげん vs. きょうげん) rather than calling them homophones.
21520_kyogen.quote: Do not confuse with the homophone 狂言, which refers to a traditional Japanese comedic theater form.

21639_suzushiikao.concern: 涼しい目 (and 涼しい目元) means clear, bright, pleasant-looking eyes, not a detached, unimpressed gaze.
21639_suzushiikao.suggestion: Describe 涼しい目 as clear, fresh-looking eyes (a compliment), or drop the item.
21639_suzushiikao.quote: 涼しい目: cool eyes — a related expression focusing on a detached, unimpressed gaze
